title: feat(playground): add option to switch between parsers
author: noahbald
summary: Adds a Parser select (style sheet vs style attribute) to the website playground and calls `transformStyleAttribute` when chosen. Small, website-only, and useful for debugging the attribute parser; master's playground has no such option.
evidence: wasm exports `transformStyleAttribute` (wasm/index.mjs). Gaps seen in the diff: `reflectPlaygroundState` isn't updated, so the parser choice is saved but not restored from shared playground links; output panes for CSS modules/dependencies may misbehave since `transformStyleAttribute` returns no exports. No maintainer comments in ~2 years; a quick look rather than a full review is enough.
